text_block_list.text:
"The day of the Kyoto Daishoten. In this 
prep race that foretells the coming autumn 
season, Kiseki—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki-kun, here we go.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In-ject-ing fight-ing spi-rit!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heeeyah~!
(Pop, pop, pop!!)

From Kiseki's shoulders, a satisfying 
popping sound is produced by Wonder 
Acute's hands.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Acute
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

When I asked Kiseki about it, it turned 
out the two of them had visited the 
waiting room at her own request.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Thanks to the two of you, I'm 
more fired up than ever...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*...!! All riiiight...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please pay it no mind. It's just a case of 
the "battle shivers"... heh heh heh!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like I could lose at all, 
honestly...!

It seems she, too, has strong feelings 
riding on this race. Her spirits are 
running exceptionally high.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh, what's the matter, Trainer...?

As I watched, her expression somehow 
seemed even more intense than usual. 
Seeing her like that, I couldn't help but—
choice_data_list: Win, go out there and win! Kisekiiii!!

text_block_list.text:
Match the mood of the world. Clench your 
fists and cheer them on.
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hell yeaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a close pair. Leaving the door 
wide open and everything.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Shall we raise a toast to these 
delightful actors?! From the edge of the 
screen!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However... The act of performing has many 
aspects beyond simply inspiring oneself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Changing my mindset, shaking off 
unnecessary thoughts from my mind. 
...Something like that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. I'm gonna win this race too."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Win, take the royal road, and charge into 
the Autumn Senior Triple Crown. —I'll give 
everyone a thrill.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will become the Umamusume who moves 
everyone's hearts the most.

And Kiseki heads toward the Kyoto 
Daishoten paddock—!
